problem.text: The README’s EXL3 model-selection link pointed to the general turboderp Hugging Face profile.

reasoning.text: The change replaces that profile URL with the EXL3 models collection URL while preserving the link label and surrounding sentence.

impact.text: Readers following the model-selection link are directed to a collection-specific destination rather than the general profile; no executable code changes.

limitations: The destination’s availability and collection contents were not verified. No useful numerical computation or runtime test applies to this URL-only documentation change.

chapters.title: Direct navigation to the EXL3 model collection

claims.text: README.md changes the Hugging Face target from https://huggingface.co/turboderp to https://huggingface.co/collections/turboderp/exl3-models-67f2dfe530f05cb9f596d21a. The visible “🤗 Hugging Face” label remains unchanged.

annotation.summary: Points the README’s EXL3 model link directly to the Hugging Face EXL3 models collection.
